description: A general structure satisfies a formula under all admissible assignments if and only if it satisfies its universal closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.GeneralModel.models_closeFormula.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (H : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.GeneralModel L)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula L) :
  H.Models (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.closeFormula φ) ↔ H.Models φ
